evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 危険物保安監督者の選任には6か月以上の危険物取扱い実務経験が必要である。
evidence.tested_misconception: 乙種免状があれば実務経験期間を問わず選任できる。
evidence.reasoning_path: license eligibility -> compare experience with six-month threshold -> determine eligibility

collision.note: Batch 2 Tier B decision boundary; distinct from C001 license-class eligibility.

independent_review.rationale: Article 13(1) directly supports the six-month practical-experience floor; the threshold scenario is independently reproducible.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review correctly applies the 600Q quality-not-quota contract. The 23 accepted candidates cover distinct statutory roles, duties, authorities, temporal boundaries, eligibility routes, enforcement triggers, or emergency obligations. C016 adds insufficient incremental practice value and must not proceed merely to preserve the planned count.
